dial.summary: BTC rallied to $86,257 (+3.8% from Oct 1) on near-zero perpetual funding (0.0067%), sustaining an unlevered spot accumulation regime as BTC.D firmed to 58.5% — alts underperforming confirms no alt-rotation signal yet; macro headwinds persist with DXY breaking to a fresh yearly high of 102.09 and real yields holding at 2.88%, but yield curve steepening to +44bps and a weak September NFP consensus (90K, releasing today at 8:30 AM ET) set up a potential macro re-pricing catalyst into October 27–28 FOMC — BTC Accumulation posture intact until DXY sustains below 100 or BTC.D sustains below 55%.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) confirmed at $103,662.82B (~$103.7T) for August 2026 per MacroMicro; small upward revision from prior $103.4T estimate after FX drag unwind; US M2 at highest level ever per Fed data; 4-week trend flat: no new official G4 aggregate beyond August; YoY still +12% (not contracting); status neutral — confirmed rising 4-week trend required for supportive; ISM manufacturing prices index surged to 77.9% in September (stagflation signal) modestly complicates the G4 liquidity expansion narrative; next meaningful update expected with September G4 M2 data (typically 6–8 week lag).

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI = 54.5%, released October 1 — ninth consecutive month of manufacturing expansion; 4-week trend flat: August 54.6% → September 54.5% = −0.1pp, within the flat threshold (<0.5% relative change); New Orders Index rose 1.6pp to 55.3% (bullish forward signal); Production Index 56.7% (−1.6pp); notable: Prices Index surged 6.8pp to 77.9% (highest since mid-2021 — stagflation risk, complicates Fed rate path); status neutral (above 50 and flat; supportive requires above 50 AND rising; headwind requires below 48 or above 62); October ISM Manufacturing releases November 3.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at ~102.09 as of early October 2, 2026 (up from 101.64 Oct 1 close; fresh yearly high per FXStreet Oct 1 report); 4-week trend up: ~99.8 (Sep 2) → 102.09 (Oct 2) = +2.3% over 4 weeks, well above the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind — DXY above 100 threshold; ISM manufacturing prices surge (77.9%) and pre-NFP safe-haven positioning are near-term dollar tailwinds; September NFP (today at 8:30 AM ET, consensus 90K vs August 162K) is the next key DXY repricing catalyst — a miss could trigger dollar reversal; a sustained close below 100 required to return to neutral.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: FRED DFII10 (10-year TIPS constant maturity) at 2.88% on October 1, 2026 (slight pullback from 2.90% on Sep 28; 10Y nominal 5.24%, 2Y nominal 4.80%); breakeven inflation ~2.28% (PCE cooling signal intact); 4-week trend up: ~2.50% (Sep 2) → 2.88% (Oct 1) = +38bps over 4 weeks; status headwind (rising 4-week trend AND above 2% absolute threshold both met); ISM Prices Index surge to 77.9% adds upside risk to breakevens and TIPS yields; October 14 CPI and October 27–28 FOMC are the next major real yield repricing catalysts; a sustained fall below 2% required to shift status to neutral.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 1, 2026: 10Y Treasury at 5.24%, 2Y at 4.80% → 2s10s spread = +0.44% (+44bps); prior Sep 30: +0.38% (+38bps); 4-week trend up (steepening): ~+38bps (Sep 2) → +44bps (Oct 1) = +6bps steepening over 4 weeks, above the 5bps flat threshold; status supportive (BOTH positive AND steepening on 4-week basis — upgrade from neutral); steepening driven by 2Y falling faster than 10Y as weak NFP consensus (90K) pulls front-end rates down; October 14 CPI and October 27–28 FOMC are the next major yield curve catalysts; deeply inverted (< −50bps) headwind threshold does not apply.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,747,704M ($6.75T) for week ending September 23, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 released September 24 (Treasuries $4,558B, MBS $1,910B, other $279B); weekly progression: Sep 2: $6,737,204M → Sep 9: $6,740,619M → Sep 16: $6,746,548M → Sep 23: $6,747,704M; 4-week trend flat: ~$6.734T (Aug 26) → $6.748T (Sep 23) = +$14B over ~4 weeks, marginal expansion within flat range; total assets up ~$140B year-on-year; status supportive (holding at post-2022 stabilization plateau; no QT acceleration announced at Sep 16 FOMC); next H.4.1 release October 2 at 4:30 PM ET (after this run) will show week ending September 30.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual funding rate at 0.0067% per 8h as of September 30, 2026 per CoinGlass (near-zero across Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget); slight step-down from prior 0.0100%, consistent with unlevered spot-driven accumulation regime; BTC spot rallied to ~$86,257 on October 2 (+3.8% from Oct 1 $83,070) on spot buying with no leverage spike; 30-day funding range consistently sub-0.010% — classic accumulation signal; BTC.D firmed to 58.5% as alts underperformed the BTC rally; status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold); October 2 NFP (today) and October 14 CPI are next potential funding regime catalysts.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$290–295B as of October 2, 2026 (stablecoin.com: $290B; stablecoinbeat.com: $302.8B; midpoint ~$292B); total crypto market cap ~$2.96T (BTC $86,257 × 20.09M supply = ~$1.73T; BTC.D 58.5% → TOTAL ~$2.96T); stablecoin dominance ~10.0%; 30-day trend down: ~10.4% (Sep 2) → ~10.0% (Oct 2) = −0.4pp over 30 days; status supportive (falling on 30-day basis; headwind condition — rising dominance AND rising TOTAL — does not apply as TOTAL is roughly flat); BTC.D rising from ~56.5% (Oct 1) to 58.5% (Oct 2) as alts underperformed BTC rally; ISM manufacturing prices surge adds mild risk-off watch for stablecoin flows.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM Services PMI for September 2026 at 10:00 AM ET — services sector is ~80% of US GDP; released after post-NFP market positioning from October 2 employment data; S&P Global Flash Services PMI surged to 58.7 (59-month high) in September, a strong leading indicator for ISM Services; prior August ISM Services was 54.2%; a print above 55 alongside a soft NFP would signal a classic late-cycle bifurcation (weak labor, resilient services) — the most challenging inflation-fighting scenario for the Fed ahead of October 27–28 FOMC.

upcoming.title: FOMC Minutes (September 15–16, 2026 Meeting)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases minutes of the September 15–16 FOMC meeting at 2:00 PM ET — the meeting at which the Fed raised the fed funds rate 25bps to 3.75%–4.00%; minutes will reveal debate around further tightening pace, any dissents, and how the committee framed the balance between inflation (PCE ~3.7% YoY, ISM prices 77.9%) and employment risks; closely watched for signals on the October 27–28 FOMC decision; 2s10s steepening to +44bps and DXY at 102.09 frame current market conditions entering the minutes release.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 3, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for week ended October 3, 2026 — first weekly claims reading fully incorporating October's early labor conditions post-September NFP; released the morning after FOMC Minutes and ahead of the FOMC blackout period; prior weeks approximately 206K; consecutive claims above 225K would signal labor market deterioration; provides a real-time labor read between NFP (Oct 2) and CPI (Oct 14) as markets price October 27–28 FOMC.
